IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Simpson, Green, Chase, Conway, McCoy, Hudgins, Hasegawa, and Moeller

Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting the use of public resources by school district officers or employees to support or oppose a teachers' strike.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the use of public resources to support or opposeteachers' strikes; and amending RCW 28A.400.332.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28A.400.332 and 2009 c 224 s 1 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No school district employee may employ or use any person,money, or property under the employee's official control or direction,in his or her official custody, without authorization, for the privatebenefit or gain of the employee or another. (((2))) (a) This ((section)) subsection does not prohibit the useof public resources to benefit others as part of the employee'sofficial duties. (((3))) (b) Each school district board of directors may adoptpolicies providing exceptions to this ((section)) subsection foroccasional use of the employee, of de minimis cost and value, if theactivity does not result in interference with the proper performance ofpublic duties. (((4))) (2) No school district officer or employee may use or p. 1 HB 2392authorize the use of public resources for the purpose of supporting oropposing a teachers' strike. (3) The office of the superintendent of public instruction shalladopt disciplinary guidelines for violations of this section.
